blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) on Thursday warned that they would disperse and take action against anyone who may trample on foreign delegates and leaders visiting the country during the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit. Several groups, including the Bagong Alyansang Makabayan, announced that they would hold public demonstrations before, during, and after the country hosts the Asean Summit to oppose the visit of United States Donald Trump.
